info.description: Tenant-scoped dossier intake, AI processing and legal review. Bearer tokens are PASETO v4.public. All JSON replies use {code,message,data}; business errors use data:null. Mutation expected_version must match dossier.version from the latest detail, otherwise HTTP 409. Tenant is never selected by client input. Worker disabled by default; configure AI and enable it to process uploads.
info.title: SEA Codex Backend API

post.description: OpenAI grounded guidance only; no dossier lookup or business mutations. Message max 2000 Unicode code points; history max 8 messages, 2000/message, 12000 total; body max 32 KiB. Roles only user/assistant. Company and permissions resolved server-side. Blocks cite retrieved IDs; server constructs sources. No chat content persisted. AI disabled/provider or audit failure returns 503. Quota is per company+actor, concurrency per instance. No-store.

post.description: Requires assignment unless company_admin. APPROVE needs VALID_DOCUMENT, no processing/missing documents, no pending/open warning/blocker. Required fields must be valid or their own unchanged FIELD_NEEDS_VERIFICATION warning must have been acknowledged by a reviewer with a reason. Unrelated acknowledgements never substitute; changed evidence requires a new acknowledgement. Accepted field IDs are recorded as accepted_required_fields in approval audit metadata, with original values and acknowledgements preserved in the private decision snapshot. REJECT/REQUEST_CHANGES require reason. Stores private decision snapshot atomically with audit/status history.
